data.narrative:
Slate Auto is a Series C-stage transportation company that has raised $1.4B to date. The target sector contains eight private peers, including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, ZeroAvia, and Harbinger; no comparable public companies exist in a sufficiently narrow peer set. The company is led by co-founders Miles Arnone and Will Barker of Re:Build Manufacturing, alongside Jeff Wilke, former CEO of Worldwide Consumer at Amazon.

Given the nascent and heterogeneous nature of the frontier transportation landscape, conventional peer-median valuation proved inapplicable—the three same-sector peers identified did not satisfy minimum clustering criteria (≥3 datapoints) within same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier buckets. Accordingly, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology, applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $1.4B cumulative capital raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $2.4B.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $2.0B to $2.7B (median $2.4B), anchored to a single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 1.7x Series C multiplier for frontier transportation, the absence of revenue or unit economics data, and the lack of granular peer benchmarking. Further validation would benefit from disclosure of operating metrics and capital deployment trajectory.
